name: Langroid
summary: Python multi-agent framework with task orchestration, typed tool messages, retrieval agents and an MCP-to-tool adapter.
description: Install langroid from PyPI (0.69.21; Python 3.10–3.13). ChatAgent components are wrapped in Tasks and can delegate to sub-tasks. Includes structured extraction, document RAG and SQL agents; MCP adapters convert server tools into ToolMessage instances. Supports remote and local models; provider authentication and service costs are separate. MIT-licensed framework, not a hosted service with a bundled free inference allowance.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install langroid. Configure model providers and any attached MCP servers independently.
